units.source_text: 又见其间夹着一枝已枯的抚子花，想是前天送老夫人信时摘得的。

en.t: He also saw that a withered pink flower had been tucked among them, apparently picked the day before when the letter was sent to the old lady.

units.source_text: 左大臣便将此花送给老夫人看，对她说道：“不能挽回之事，今已无可奈何了。

en.t: The Minister of the Left showed the flower to the old lady and said to her, "What cannot be undone can no longer be helped now.

units.source_text: 仔细想来，此等可悲的逆事，世间并非没有。

en.t: When I think carefully, such sorrowful reversals are not unknown in this world.

units.source_text: 多管是与女儿宿缘不深，致使我等遭此苦厄。

en.t: Perhaps our destined bond with our daughter was not deep, and so we have met with this suffering.

units.source_text: 如此一想，我反而怨恨前世冤孽，悼念之心也断绝了。

en.t: Thinking of it this way, I came instead to resent the karmic wrongs of a former life, and even my heart for mourning was cut off.

units.source_text: 岂知日月推迁，恋念愈深，痛苦难堪。

en.t: But as the days and months passed, my longing only grew deeper, and the pain became unbearable.

units.source_text: 况且这大将今后将成为外人，岂不可惜？

en.t: Besides, this general will now become a stranger to us; how can that not be a pity?
It breaks my heart so deeply!

units.source_text: 回忆往日一二日不见，或踪迹稍疏，我便忽忽若有所失，胸中闷闷不乐。

en.t: I remember that in the past, if I did not see him for even a day or two, or if his visits grew only a little less frequent, I would feel dazed as though I had lost something, and my heart would be heavy and joyless.

units.source_text: 今后缘断，我家便似失却了日月光华，教我如何活下去呢？”

en.t: If our bond is severed from now on, our house will be as though it has lost the light of the sun and moon; how am I to go on living?"

units.source_text: 伤心之极，不禁放声大哭。

en.t: Overcome with grief, he could not hold back and burst into loud sobs.

units.source_text: 左右几个年纪较大的侍女，睹此情状，不胜悲痛，同声号哭起来。

en.t: Several older ladies-in-waiting nearby saw this scene and, unable to bear their sorrow, began wailing together.

units.source_text: 这夕暮的光景好不凄凉！

en.t: How desolate that evening scene was!
